title: Universal Semantic Graph Serialized Schema
description: Machine-readable contract for the portable serialized form of the repository's library-independent SemanticGraph.

id.description: Stable semantic identifier within the graph. Backends may create local indices but must retain a reversible mapping.

type.description: Open, domain-extensible semantic entity type. The core schema intentionally defines no closed enumeration.

attributes.description: Domain-level properties describing the represented entity.

metadata.description: Record, extraction, processing, or provenance metadata.

relation.description: Open, domain-extensible semantic relation type. The core schema intentionally defines no closed enumeration.

attributes.description: Domain-level properties describing the semantic relationship.

metadata.description: Record, extraction, processing, or provenance metadata for the relationship.
